vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At d7962710^, buildDefaultDashboard emits every non-hidden, not-already-placed binding and buildAction exposes binding metadata while consulting IsAllowedExec only; GetActionBinding returns the same Action without IsAllowedView. An authenticated user with view:false can therefore enumerate titles, IDs, icons, descriptions, and arguments while canExec remains false.

atomic_bic.evidence: a62d58f11955fe192f45da13e23ba996a2759404 first writes buildDefaultDashboard's unfiltered MapActionIdToBinding loop and simultaneously removes the former filtered action-list construction. Blame and path history trace the vulnerable loop to this commit. Although broad, it is the smallest surviving public commit object for that first write.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Immediate parent d4fe9eaa793f508f44bc60f0a1109cb008a6a5b0 is present and safe for this mechanism: service/internal/grpcapi/grpcApiActions.go filters the dashboard action list with acl.IsAllowedView at lines 27-30, and buildDefaultDashboard does not yet exist. Thus introducer_parent_absent=false is correct.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: a62d58f has exactly one parent, is not a merge commit, and GitHub reports no associated pull request or reconstructable public member commits. No finer public member is available, so squash_decomposed=false and decomposed_shas=[] are appropriate despite the commit's large rewrite scope.

affected_fixed_release_membership.evidence: CVE-2026-30233 is PUBLISHED and declares versions before 3000.11.1 affected. Git ancestry confirms a62d58f is contained in 3000.0.0 and 3000.11.0; d7962710 is absent from 3000.11.0 (tag commit 235493e471249b07cf20abdf5850f9ba38d8effa) and contained in 3000.11.1 (tag commit 276e3f62ddb87f9cb87903b19203e35db01a0c95).

direct_fix_or_unpatched.evidence: Advisory-cited d7962710e7c46f6bdda4188b5b0cdbde4be665a0 is a direct fix: it adds IsAllowedView filtering to buildDefaultDashboard and findActionForEntity and returns PermissionDenied from GetActionBinding when view is denied, with targeted regression tests.
